masterPrompts.portal:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one approval master frame of a finish-line portal for a 2D side-scrolling platformer; NOT a sprite sheet or animation yet.
Input references: Preview (Characters).png and Sample A.png are STYLE references only for the Kenney New Platformer Pack. Do not copy the montage, text, logo, characters or background.
Create exactly ONE upright circular magical exit portal viewed face-on as a flat 2D game sprite, for the player to touch and enter at the finish. A chunky warm sand-gold ring with thick charcoal outlines surrounds a clearly open luminous turquoise/sea-green spiral. Three broad curved energy bands curl inward, with a darker teal center to convey depth using flat colors. The inner swirl and two understated asymmetrical rim marks establish a visible clockwise rotation phase for a later looping sprite animation. The external silhouette must remain circular and centered through rotation. Make it friendly and readable, not menacing. No doors, buildings, floor tiles, pedestal, scenery, character, arrows or lettering.
Style must match the supplied asset pack: bold dark charcoal outlines, rounded shapes, simple two-tone flat shading, crisp cartoon raster edges, minimal detail. Gold and sea-green clearly distinguish the goal from red/blue/purple special floors. Keep any aura thin, gentle, and bounded close to the ring; no detached sparks or huge glow. No realistic metal/stone texture, painterly rendering, realistic 3D perspective, dense fantasy runes or pixel art.
Canvas/frame contract: square 1024x1024 RGBA, genuinely transparent background, one frame/one cell. Center and future rotation anchor exactly (512,512). Ring plus all energy/aura must fit within x=144..880, y=144..880, with at least 128px fully clear margin on every edge. Complete uncut circular silhouette, 1:1 face-on proportions, no cast shadow. Designed for clear reading around 128px in game. Only this single neutral rotation-phase master image is needed for the user's art-style approval.
